briefdescription.para: Focused tests: GossipAdapterPublisher wired into LLMPluginManager.

detaileddescription.para: GAP-01 setAdapterPublisher(nullptr) is safe (no-op) GAP-02 setAdapterPublisher() stores publisher; lastAnnouncement is empty before any load GAP-03 loadLoRA() triggers announce() → lastAnnouncement() reflects the LoRA id GAP-04 unloadLoRA() triggers withdrawal announcement GAP-05 No publisher set → loadLoRA/unloadLoRA work without any gossip call
